name: wellllai
description: AI learning and interview training platform

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @wellllai/contracts && npm run build -w @wellllai/platform
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @wellllai/api-gateway && npm run build -w @wellllai/knowledge-service && npm run build -w @wellllai/learning-service && npm run build -w @wellllai/interview-service && npm run build -w @wellllai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
